title: Deduplicate some version variables.
description:
Use PROJECT_VERSION instead of VERSION. Prepend "PROJECT_" or
"LOG_PROJECT_" as needed to other variables. Remove the leftover unused
variables.

notes.body:
added 1 commit

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/7107/diffs?diff_id=411387602&start_sha=6fc2c51be69103502f6871779f6b32768baecefa)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for c5e265f8527dc05a5f9c19e8d6b41b7c19077e3f succeeds

commits_data.title: CMake: Deduplicate some version variables.
commits_data.message:
CMake: Deduplicate some version variables.

Use PROJECT_VERSION instead of VERSION. Prepend "PROJECT_" or
"LOG_PROJECT_" as needed to other variables. Remove the leftover unused
variables.
